verdicts.reason: A: the SOLSTICE can, the hero product, is shrunk to a tiny thumbnail jammed into the bottom-left corner. That leaves the purple panel as a huge empty band in the middle. The logo floats right-aligned while the headline and subcopy are left-aligned, and the centred CTA shares no edge with them. B: the same failure — the purple panel is an empty half-canvas, and the can is a tiny orphan under the CTA. Its right text column is coherent, though, apart from the CTA being indented off the text edge and an orphaned 'herbs.' line, so it is marginally less broken.
